claims.claim_en: 'عجَبًا' is the predicate (khabar) of the verb 'كَانَ' (i.e. خبر كان).
'min āyātinā' functions as a ḥāl (circumstantial accusative) modifying 'كَانُوا'.

claims.claim_ar: يَجُوزُ أَنْ يَكُونَا خَبَرَيْنِ (أي: «عَجَبًا» وَ«مِنْ آيَاتِنَا» خَبَرَانِ لِـ «كَانُوا»).
claims.claim_en: It is permissible to parse the two phrases as two predicates (two khabars) of 'كَانُوا' — i.e. both 'عجَبًا' and 'مِنْ آيَاتِنَا' as khabarayn.

claims.source_quote_ar: وَيَجُوزُ أَنْ يَكُونَ «عَجَبًا» حَالًا مِنَ الضَّمِيرِ فِي الْجَارِّ.
claims.claim_ar: يَجُوزُ أَنْ يَكُونَ «عَجَبًا» حَالًا مِنَ الضَّمِيرِ فِي الْجَارِّ.
claims.claim_en: Alternatively, 'عجَبًا' may be read as a ḥāl (circumstantial) referring to the pronoun contained in the genitive (i.e. the pronoun of the prepositional phrase), rather than as predicate of 'كَانُوا'.
